description: Reads the temperature, humidity and battery state of a TP-Link Tapo T310 or T315 sensor paired with a Tapo hub (H100), over the local, encrypted KLAP protocol.

outputs.name: Temperature
outputs.description: Last measured temperature in °C, corrected by the offset. Keeps its last value while there is a fault.

outputs.name: Humidity
outputs.description: Last measured relative humidity in %. Keeps its last value while there is a fault.

outputs.name: Low battery
outputs.description: True when the sensor reports a low battery

outputs.name: Fault
outputs.description: 0 - reading ok, -1 - hub unreachable or sensor offline, 1000 not configured, 1001 credentials refused, 1002 not KLAP, 1003 session dropped, 1004 request rejected, 1005 sensor not on the hub

config.name: Hub address
config.description: Address of the Tapo hub in the local network, for example 192.168.1.50, optionally with a port. No http:// and no path. Give the hub a fixed address in the router so that it does not change.

config.name: E-mail
config.description: E-mail of the TP-Link account the hub was set up with in the Tapo app

config.name: Password
config.description: Password of the TP-Link account used in the Tapo app

config.name: Sensor
config.description: Name of the sensor as given in the Tapo app, or its device ID. Leave empty to use the first temperature and humidity sensor paired with the hub.

config.name: Refresh interval
config.description: How often the hub is asked for the readings, in seconds

config.name: Temperature offset
config.description: Correction added to the measured temperature, in °C

state.name: In flight
state.description: True while waiting for the hub to answer

state.name: Request start
state.description: Uptime in milliseconds when the pending request was sent, used to give up on a lost answer

state.name: Page start
state.description: Index of the first child device in the requested page of the hub's list

state.name: Last refresh
state.description: Timestamp of the last scheduled refresh in seconds since epoch

state.name: Next refresh
state.description: Timestamp of the next scheduled refresh in seconds since epoch
